description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'MainScaffold' that creates a bottom navigation layout with four screens: Dashboard, Transactions, Categories, and Settings. It manages navigation state and renders different screens based on user interaction.

classes.name: MainScaffold
classes.description: A stateful widget that provides the main scaffold with bottom navigation for the app.

classes.name: _MainScaffoldState
classes.description: State class for MainScaffold managing selected index and rendering views.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MainScaffold.

methods.name: _onItemTapped
methods.description: Updates the current index when a bottom navigation item is tapped.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the main scaffold including the body and bottom navigation bar.
